officialTitle: Nivolumab versus Docetaxel in Advanced Nonsquamous Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
clinicalQuestion: Does nivolumab improve overall survival over docetaxel in previously treated advanced non-squamous NSCLC?

pico.population: Advanced non-squamous NSCLC progressing during or after platinum-based doublet chemotherapy
pico.outcomes: Primary: OS. Secondary: ORR, PFS, PD-L1 subgroups, safety

arms.label: Nivolumab
arms.doseSourceQuote: to receive nivolumab at a dose of 3 mg per kilogram of body weight every 2 weeks

arms.label: Docetaxel
arms.doseSourceQuote: or docetaxel at a dose of 75 mg per square meter of body-surface area every 3 weeks

publications.title: Nivolumab versus Docetaxel in Advanced Nonsquamous Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
publications.label: Primary analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: The median overall survival was 12.2 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 9.7 to 15.0) among 292 patients in the nivolumab group and 9.4 months (95% CI, 8.1 to 10.7) among 290 patients in the docetaxel group (hazard ratio for death, 0.73; 96% CI, 0.59 to 0.89; P=0.002).

At 1 year, the overall survival rate was 51% (95% CI, 45 to 56) with nivolumab versus 39% (95% CI, 33 to 45) with docetaxel. With additional follow-up, the overall survival rate at 18 months was 39% (95% CI, 34 to 45) with nivolumab versus 23% (95% CI, 19 to 28) with docetaxel.
The response rate was 19% with nivolumab versus 12% with docetaxel (P=0.02).

Although progression-free survival did not favor nivolumab over docetaxel (median, 2.3 months and 4.2 months, respectively), the rate of progression-free survival at 1 year was higher with nivolumab than with docetaxel (19% and 8%, respectively).

safety.description: Treatment-related adverse events of grade 3 or 4
safety.sourceQuote: Treatment-related adverse events of grade 3 or 4 were reported in 10% of the patients in the nivolumab group, as compared with 54% of those in the docetaxel group.

strengths: Randomised phase III with OS primary endpoint
limitations: Median PFS did not favour nivolumab; early deaths/progression in a subset

clinicalImplications.text: Established nivolumab over docetaxel in previously treated advanced non-squamous NSCLC, with greater benefit in PD-L1-expressing tumours.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Crossing survival curves: median PFS favoured docetaxel, yet landmark PFS and OS favoured nivolumab — durable responders drive the benefit.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 26412456. OS HR reported with 96% CI.
